evidence.title: 10-Year Treasury Inflation-Indexed Security, Constant Maturity
evidence.summary: The snapshotted target change was 0.25 percentage points; it resolved to 'above recent range'.

evidence.title: US Real Yield Is At A 14-Year High, What’s Next For Bitcoin?
evidence.summary: This article directly states that the US real yield on 10-year Treasuries reached 1.84% on August 14, rising by six basis points to a multi-year high. This provides a specific data point for the 10-year real yield within the target month and indicates an upward trend.

evidence.title: The Deflation Is Here, and It Wasn't the Rate Hikes | RealClearMarkets
evidence.summary: This article, though published earlier, provides context on the significant rise in real yields across the curve over the past year, specifically mentioning 10-year TIPS yields rising more than 2-1/4 percentage points to 1.2 percent. This establishes a baseline of rising real yields leading into the target period.

evidence.title: Fed done hiking; slim majority of economists say no rate cut through March: Reuters poll | Reuters
evidence.summary: This article discusses the expectation that rates will stay higher for longer, leading to 'convulsions in bond markets' and notes that the benchmark 10-year Treasury note yield was 'only a few basis points off its cycle high in October'. This indicates upward pressure on nominal yields, which often correlates with real yields.

evidence.title: Monthly Market Wrap: July 2023 - YCharts
evidence.summary: This report details that in July, short and long-term US Treasury yields shot higher, with the 10-Year rising by 16 basis points. While this is a nominal yield, it sets a precedent for upward movement in long-term yields immediately preceding the target month.

evidence.title: US inflation has steadily cooled. Getting it down to the Fed's target rate will be the toughest mile | AP News
evidence.summary: This article mentions that the Fed might feel compelled to further raise its key rate from its current 5.4% if inflation remains elevated. Higher policy rates generally translate to higher nominal and real yields.

evidence.title: July Inflation Report Inflation Remains Moderate as High Interest Rates Bite
evidence.summary: This article notes that the 10-year Treasury yield 'inched below 4 percent' after the fresh inflation figures. While this suggests a slight downward movement in nominal yields, the overall context of high interest rates and the Fed's stance on inflation still points to upward pressure on real yields.

evidence.title: Inflation rises for first time in 12 months
evidence.summary: This article reports that interest rates are expected to remain near 4% through 2024, based on the Fed's projections, and that current interest rates are at a 22-year high (5.25% to 5.5%). This reinforces the 'higher for longer' narrative, which supports higher real yields.

evidence.title: Latest CPI Report Offers Further Evidence Of Easing Inflation For Fed
evidence.summary: This article discusses the July CPI report showing 'easing inflation' and suggests it 'may cause the Fed to be less committed to another 2023 interest rate hike'. While easing inflation could theoretically reduce real yields, the overall context of the Fed's high benchmark rate and the 'higher for longer' sentiment still dominates.
